# The ONLY engine skills left turned on for a client agent.
# One per line; anything starting with # is a comment.
#
# Everything else gets turned off with `skills.disabled` in config.yaml — the
# list is generated by tools/skills-knob.py, never written by hand. This file
# is the exception, i.e. the policy: read by the generator and by
# agent-check.py.
#
# Why these four and no others: they're the ones that read the documents a
# client sends over chat (a spreadsheet, a PDF, a Word doc, a photo of a
# receipt). Without them the agent gets a file and can't open it. None of
# them talk outward, none publish anything, and none touch other systems:
# they read what was already sent to them.
xlsx
pdf
ocr-and-documents
# At a small business, contracts, briefs and proposals go in Word, not PDF.
# Without this one, the agent asks "send it to me in PDF" and the client eats
# the work.
docx
